findings.how_to_check: Run `git grep -n "4,089,300" -- .` to confirm the count exists only in LINKAGE/DOCUMENTATION.md:242; inspect replication/run_machineB.log to confirm it contains only the 314-line preflight run; inspect LINKAGE/code/02_hlink/linkage_analysis_newlinks.do:501-503, 551-589 to verify that status pair counts are only displayed via `tab status` and not exported.
findings.suggested_fix: In LINKAGE/code/02_hlink/linkage_analysis_newlinks.do, add repnum commands to export the pair-change totals (added, removed, changed, unchanged) to replication/results/linkage_hlink.tex. Register them in replication/claims.toml and update LINKAGE/DOCUMENTATION.md to reference that tracked result file.
findings.title: Reported HLINK pair counts depend on an overwritten log with no tracked result artifact
findings.what_the_code_does: The driver at replication/Run-MachineB.ps1:54 now routes preflight output to `run_machineB_preflight.log` and full run output to `run_machineB.log`, preventing future preflight runs from overwriting the full log. However, LINKAGE/DOCUMENTATION.md:208-211 notes that the HLINK changed/unchanged pair counts (4,089,300 added, 2,399,411 removed, 306,435 changed, 64,075,928 unchanged) 'were transcribed on 2026-11-10 from that run''s Stata log, since overwritten'. The driver change protects future logs but cannot recover the lost evidence for the currently reported figures.
findings.why_it_matters: While the counts can be recomputed by a four-hour full run on machine B, the specific evidence underlying the numbers in the repo documentation cannot presently be audited. Because neither the LaTeX tables nor repnum record these pair-status counts, any transcription error in the manual values would go undetected by automated verification scripts like check_claims.py.

review_limits: No paper draft was supplied, so claims in the paper draft could not be compared with the code.

Data files on external drives (F:\Deaglan\Census_Transcriptions\ and D:\Dropbox) are gitignored and not readable in this sandbox, and the ~4-hour machine-B pipeline was not executed; runtime outcomes were evaluated from source code, manifests, and checked-in logs.

The external paper repository (F:\github_repos\6638fa0fd89fbec05130caeb) and commit 3ca56d2 referenced in replication/README.md were not directly inspected; statements regarding external paper repo commits could not be independently verified.

Identification review was limited to evaluating the uncommitted changes in the working tree, which do not modify any empirical specifications, sample restrictions, linkage thresholds, or estimation routines.
structured_output.summary: The uncommitted changes successfully prevent preflight runs from overwriting the full machine-B log in replication/Run-MachineB.ps1 and accurately document the 2026-11-09 run and Table 12 pipeline in replication/README.md and LINKAGE/DOCUMENTATION.md. One replication gap remains: reported HLINK pair-change counts in LINKAGE/DOCUMENTATION.md currently rest on a manual transcription from a destroyed log rather than a tracked artifact. On the next full run, these counts should be exported via repnum to a tracked results file and registered in claims.toml.

summary.description: Two to four sentences. The overall state of the reviewed work and the single most important thing to fix. No preamble.

dimensions_reviewed.description: Which scope dimensions were actually reviewed in this run.

findings.description: Defects and concerns, ordered most severe first. Empty if none. Do not pad with stylistic observations.

severity.description: blocker: a reported result is wrong. major: a referee would demand it. minor: real but survivable. nit: cosmetic.

confidence.description: verified: traced in the source. likely: strongly implied but depends on unseen data. speculative: a question, not an established defect.

title.description: One line, stating the defect itself, not its category.

location.description: path:line, or path:line-line. Several may be comma-separated. Required: a finding without a location is not a finding.

what_the_code_does.description: Precisely what the code computes, quoting the relevant expression. Contrast with what it was evidently intended to compute.

why_it_matters.description: The consequence for a number or claim in the paper. If there is no consequence, the severity is nit.

how_to_check.description: A concrete command, tabulation, or count the author can run to confirm or refute this in minutes.

suggested_fix.description: The change, specific enough to act on. Do not apply it yourself.

verified_clean.description: Things explicitly checked that were fine. This is what makes a short findings list trustworthy rather than lazy.

evidence.description: How it was confirmed, with path:line where applicable.

review_limits.description: What this review could NOT establish: data not readable, pipeline not runnable, paper text unavailable, Stata semantics not verifiable by reading. Be explicit; silence here reads as false assurance.
